breakdown.description: Thermal expansion coefficient beta for an ideal gas is approximately 1/T in absolute units (Kelvin); using Celsius temperature in beta = 1/T is incorrect.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use beta = 1/(T_C) where T_C is the film temperature in Celsius,' which directly repeats the original error. The ground truth requires beta = 1/T_abs evaluated at the film temperature in Kelvin. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
